rakez-erp.title: Rakez ERP
rakez-erp.positioning: Real estate ERP with CRM, commission automation, and Arabic AI assistant
rakez-erp.type: Real Estate ERP / CRM / AI Assistant
rakez-erp.problem: Real estate companies in the region managed sales pipelines, multi-party commissions, booking workflows, and marketing budgets across disconnected tools — with no Arabic-native system available.
rakez-erp.role: Lead backend engineer. Designed the full REST API architecture (150+ endpoints), RBAC system (67+ permissions across 9 roles), commission calculation engine with VAT, booking/reservation workflow with waiting lists, and integrated the OpenAI-powered AI assistant with Arabic language support.
rakez-erp.architecture: Laravel 12 monolith. PostgreSQL for relational data. Redis for caching, queues, and session management. Laravel Reverb for real-time WebSocket notifications. Spatie Permission for granular RBAC. OpenAI API integration for the AI assistant module. Sanctum for API authentication.
rakez-erp.challenges: Multi-party commission distribution with approval chains and VAT calculation. Concurrent booking conflicts with waiting list queuing. 67+ permissions mapped across 9 roles without performance degradation. Arabic language AI responses with business-context accuracy.
rakez-erp.aiFeatures: OpenAI-powered assistant handles Arabic natural language queries from sales teams. Commission engine automates multi-party split calculations. Marketing budget tracker integrates Facebook SDK and TikTok API spend data.
rakez-erp.impact: 150+ protected API endpoints serving complex business operations. Automated commission calculations that previously required manual spreadsheet work. Real-time booking notifications reduced missed follow-ups. AI assistant adopted by sales team for daily Arabic-language queries.

matjrii.title: Matjrii SaaS
matjrii.positioning: Multi-store e-commerce SaaS with 27+ payment gateways and AI content
matjrii.problem: SMBs in the MENA region needed an affordable way to launch online stores without technical expertise — supporting local and international payment gateways, multiple languages, and professional themes out of the box.
matjrii.role: Full-stack development with backend focus. Built the multi-tenant store isolation engine, payment gateway abstraction layer (27+ providers including Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay), inventory management system, POS integration, and AI-powered product content generation via OpenAI API.
matjrii.architecture: Laravel backend with React/Inertia.js frontend. Multi-tenant architecture with row-level store isolation. MySQL/PostgreSQL dual support. 27+ payment gateway integrations through a unified abstraction layer. OpenAI API for automated product descriptions and SEO content.
matjrii.challenges: Tenant isolation ensuring no data leakage between stores. Payment gateway abstraction that normalizes 27+ provider APIs into a single interface. Theme engine supporting 10+ designs without code changes per store. Inventory sync across POS and online channels.
matjrii.aiFeatures: AI-generated product descriptions reduce store setup time. Automated SEO content for product pages. Multi-language content support across 22+ languages.
matjrii.impact: Platform supports unlimited store creation. 22+ language options serve MENA and international merchants. AI content generation cuts initial store setup effort. Role-based permissions allow store owners to delegate staff access.

restocafe.title: RestoCafe OS
restocafe.positioning: Multi-branch restaurant POS with offline PWA, QR ordering, and real-time kitchen ops
restocafe.type: Restaurant POS / QR Ordering / Kitchen Operations
restocafe.problem: Restaurant chains needed a modern POS that works offline during internet outages, handles real-time kitchen display across branches, and supports QR-based customer ordering — without proprietary hardware lock-in.
restocafe.role: Backend architecture and system design. Built the NestJS API layer with TypeScript, multi-tenant branch isolation, real-time kitchen display system via Socket.IO, offline-first PWA with service workers, and optimistic concurrency control for concurrent order processing.
restocafe.architecture: NestJS with TypeScript. PostgreSQL with schema-level tenant isolation per branch. Socket.IO for real-time kitchen display updates. Redux for frontend state management. Service workers for offline PWA capability. Docker/Kubernetes deployment. Redis for caching. Prometheus for monitoring.
restocafe.challenges: Offline-first order processing with conflict resolution on reconnect. Optimistic concurrency control preventing double-charges on simultaneous order updates. Real-time kitchen display synchronization across multiple terminals. Branch-level data isolation in a shared database.
restocafe.aiFeatures: Real-time order routing to kitchen stations based on item category. QR code self-ordering reduces waiter dependency. Audit logging tracks every order state transition for dispute resolution.
restocafe.impact: Offline-capable POS eliminates downtime during internet outages. Real-time kitchen display reduces order preparation errors. Multi-tenant branch isolation enables centralized management. Load-tested for multi-replica Kubernetes deployments.

medical.title: Medical Booking System
medical.positioning: Healthcare appointment platform with scheduling, payments, and AI-assisted workflow automation
medical.problem: Healthcare providers needed a unified platform for appointment scheduling, patient records, digital payments, and automated reminders — with strict multi-role access control separating admin, doctor, and patient workflows.
medical.role: Backend development. Built the appointment scheduling engine with conflict detection, payment processing integration (Stripe configured), automated reminder infrastructure, AI-assisted booking and communication module, and multi-role access control system.
medical.architecture: Laravel backend with MySQL. Redis for session management and caching. Payment processing via Stripe integration. Automated reminder system for appointment follow-ups. AI-assisted booking assistant for patient communication. Role-based middleware for admin/doctor/patient separation.
medical.challenges: Appointment conflict detection across multiple doctors and time zones. Payment state management handling refunds and subscription billing. Multi-role access control ensuring strict data separation between admin, doctor, and patient workflows. Automated reminder scheduling with delivery tracking.
medical.aiFeatures: AI-assisted administrative summaries, patient communication support, and workflow automation. Automated reminders reduce no-show rates. Subscription management handles recurring appointment packages.
medical.impact: Automated scheduling eliminates manual coordination overhead. Reminder system measurably reduces patient no-shows. Payment integration supports subscription and one-time billing. AI-assisted workflows support administrative efficiency.

leadscope.title: LeadScope AI / ProspectIQ
leadscope.positioning: FastAPI lead intelligence platform with AI scoring and async enrichment pipeline
leadscope.problem: Sales teams spent hours manually researching each prospect across multiple data sources. They needed automated lead enrichment, AI-powered scoring, and a clean API that integrates with existing CRM frontends.
leadscope.role: Designed and built the entire backend: FastAPI with Pydantic v2 for request/response validation, SQLAlchemy 2 ORM with Alembic migrations, OpenAI-powered lead scoring engine, async enrichment pipeline, and RESTful API for CRM integration. Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions running ruff, mypy, pytest, and Playwright.
leadscope.architecture: Python FastAPI with async endpoints. MariaDB via SQLAlchemy 2 ORM. Pydantic v2 for strict input/output validation. Alembic for database migrations. OpenAI API for lead scoring and enrichment. Redis for caching enrichment results. React/TypeScript/Vite frontend. Docker Compose for local development. GitHub Actions CI with ruff, mypy, pytest, Playwright.
leadscope.challenges: Async enrichment pipeline that doesn't block the API response cycle. Structured JSON output from LLMs that matches Pydantic schemas reliably. Rate limiting OpenAI calls while maintaining enrichment throughput. Type-safe Python codebase enforced by mypy in CI.
leadscope.aiFeatures: AI-powered lead scoring prioritizes high-value prospects. LLM enrichment extracts structured company and contact data. Structured JSON outputs validated against Pydantic schemas. Prompt context design ensures consistent scoring criteria.
leadscope.impact: Automated enrichment eliminates manual prospect research. AI scoring provides actionable lead prioritization. Type-safe codebase with full CI pipeline (ruff + mypy + pytest + Playwright). RESTful API integrates cleanly with existing CRM workflows.

ilogistics.title: iLogistics SaaS
ilogistics.positioning: Logistics and booking management platform with multi-tenant operations and query-optimized reporting
ilogistics.problem: A logistics company needed a SaaS platform to manage multi-tenant booking operations, shipment tracking, driver assignments, and business reporting — replacing spreadsheet-based workflows that couldn't scale.
ilogistics.role: Backend developer. Designed and built RESTful APIs for the entire platform using Laravel and MySQL. Implemented multi-tenant operations, JWT authentication, RBAC authorization, tracking data endpoints, analytics dashboards, and complex business reporting features. Optimized database queries with 25+ indexes and eager loading for measurable performance gains.
ilogistics.architecture: Laravel backend with MySQL. Redis for caching and session management. JWT-based authentication with RBAC middleware. RESTful API serving web and mobile clients. Tracking data endpoints for shipment status. Analytics and reporting engine with optimized queries.
ilogistics.challenges: Query optimization across large tracking datasets (25+ indexes added). Multi-tenant data isolation with shared database architecture. JWT token lifecycle management for mobile and web clients. Complex reporting aggregations that needed to respond within acceptable latency.
ilogistics.aiFeatures: Business reporting engine with complex aggregation queries. Tracking data pipeline for shipment status updates. Analytics dashboards for operational decision-making. Automated notification workflows for booking status changes.
ilogistics.impact: Measurable performance improvement across tracking and reporting modules after query optimization (indexing, eager loading). Multi-tenant platform replaced manual spreadsheet workflows. JWT-based auth secured operations across web and mobile clients. Reporting dashboards enabled data-driven operational decisions.

transition.heading: From business problems to production systems.
transition.body: Every project below started as an operational bottleneck — a spreadsheet, a manual process, a disconnected tool. What follows is the backend engineering that replaced it.
signals: 150+ protected API endpoints in ERP/CRM work

caseStudy.coverNote: Art direction concept — not a product screenshot

abstraction.heading: One pattern, six systems.
abstraction.body: Every platform above reduces to the same backend spine: a business operation, guarded by roles and permissions, modeled as data, exposed through APIs, wired into integrations, and tracked by an audit trail.

steps.title: Business operation
steps.body: A real workflow — booking, ordering, prescribing, shipping — that used to run on spreadsheets or phone calls.

steps.title: Actors & roles
steps.body: Admins, staff, customers, drivers — each with a different view of the same operation.

steps.title: Permissions
steps.body: Role-based access control scoping exactly what each actor can see and do.

steps.title: Domain model
steps.body: Relational schemas that capture the business rules — bookings, inventory, commissions, appointments.

steps.title: APIs
steps.body: REST endpoints that expose the domain model to web and mobile clients securely.

steps.title: Integrations
steps.body: Payments, AI assistants, notification and marketing platforms wired into the core flow.

steps.title: Audit trail
steps.body: Every state change logged — for disputes, compliance, and operational visibility.

gallery.heading: Additional systems
gallery.body: Four more production platforms — same backend-first approach, different domains.

closing.heading: Building the systems behind the business.
closing.body: If your product needs someone who can turn operational complexity into secure, maintainable backend architecture — let's talk.
